Definition: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
BiblicalUsage: n m; 1) nation, people; 1a) nation, people; 1a1) usually of non-Hebrew people; 1a2) of descendants of Abraham; 1a3) of Israel; 1b) of swarm of locusts, other animals (fig.); n pr m; 1c) Goyim? = "nations"
